text.arabic_uthmani: أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۗ وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ ۚ أَمْ تُنَبِّـُٔونَهُۥ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَم بِظَٰهِرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ ۗ بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مَكْرُهُمْ وَصُدُّوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ

words.gloss_range: interrogative opening joined to a resumptive/consequential connector
words.prose: {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:a-fa}}) fuses interrogation with forward motion. The particle carries the prior punishment question forward as a fresh rhetorical comparison, so the argument remains one chain of consequence before the subject is named.

topics.headline: rhetorical opening carried forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question begins as a live continuation of the preceding argument, not as a detached puzzle.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 1 converge on rhetorical opening carried forward; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun anchoring an unfinished rhetorical comparison
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) anchors the opening comparison as a relative pronoun, with the opposing predicate suppressed. That ellipsis sharpens the challenge: who could be set beside the One described in the following predicate?

topics.headline: relative subject with suppressed comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah asks about a specific kind of One while leaving the absurd comparison to be supplied.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 2 converge on relative subject with suppressed comparison; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun separating subject and predicate for emphasis
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) stands between the relative pronoun and the predicate, making the subject unmistakable and blocking the standing predicate from being heard as a loose adjective. The wording slows the syntax to foreground exclusive divine identity before universal oversight is described.

topics.headline: separating pronoun emphasizes the divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine subject is isolated before the predicate of oversight is stated.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 3 converge on separating pronoun emphasizes the divine subject; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: active participle predicate for continuing divine oversight, not a one-time action
words.root_gloss_range: standing, establishing, maintaining, straightening, and rising; locally narrowed to sustained oversight
words.prose: {{ar:قَآئِمٌ}} ({{tr:qāʾimun}}) is an indefinite active participle, so the opening predicate feels ongoing: standing over, maintaining, and overseeing. The broader {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) field brings establishment, straightening, and final-standing pressure, but the following oversight phrase narrows it to supervisory dominion while the participial force helps frame the later absent guide.

topics.headline: ongoing standing as oversight and maintenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening predicate presents continuing oversight and maintenance, not a static title.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 4 converge on ongoing standing as oversight and maintenance; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking supervisory authority over its object
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) turns the standing predicate toward authority over what follows. It makes the opening image supervisory: the One is over every self in a domain of control, not merely above it in space.

topics.headline: authority-over rather than mere location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relation is one of oversight and dominion rather than simple spatial placement.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 5 converge on authority-over rather than mere location; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: construct noun of totality binding every instance of self into the scope
words.root_gloss_range: totality and completeness; locally the distributive force of every individual self
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) binds totality to the following self noun in construct. The singular form does not shrink the scope; it distributes oversight instance by instance across every self.

topics.headline: exhaustive distributive totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine oversight is distributed over every single self without exception.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 6 converge on exhaustive distributive totality; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular self governed by totality in the oversight phrase
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, person, breath, and desire; locally narrowed to the accountable living self
words.prose: {{ar:نَفْسٍ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}) receives the force of the totality term, so the oversight is not abstract humanity but every individual self. The {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) range of self, breath, preciousness, and appetite is narrowed here to the living, desiring agent whose acquisition is known.

topics.headline: individual accountable self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accountability reaches each living self as an individual case.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 7 converge on individual accountable self; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: preposition linking oversight to what has been acquired
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the opening oversight to what each self has acquired. Its causal and instrumental pressure makes the phrase point toward accountability for earned action.

topics.headline: earned cause attached to oversight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that oversight is tied to earned outcome, not left as general surveillance.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 8 converge on earned cause attached to oversight; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun opening the content of what was earned
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the relative clause after the preceding preposition. Because the object is not specified narrowly, the wording leaves the whole content of what was earned available for reckoning.

topics.headline: open-ended acquired object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the acquired object is left maximally open, allowing the whole record of acquisition into view.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 9 converge on open-ended acquired object; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: perfect feminine verb agreeing with self and naming acquired responsibility
words.root_gloss_range: earning, acquiring, gaining merit, and incurring fault; locally not the more effort-marked Form VIII
words.prose: {{ar:كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:kasabat}}) agrees with the self noun and completes the opening accountability clause. The {{ar:ك س ب}} ({{tr:k-s-b}}) range includes gain, merit, and sin, but the local Form I keeps the focus on what the self has acquired rather than intensifying it into the Form VIII profile.

topics.headline: completed acquisition by the self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that each self stands under oversight for completed acquisition, without shifting to the heavier reflexive sense of Form VIII.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 10 converge on completed acquisition by the self; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector shifting from divine oversight to human partner-making
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes with contrastive pressure. It pivots from the One standing over every self to the human fabrication that follows.

topics.headline: pivot from oversight to fabrication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turns from God’s total oversight to the human act of assigning partners.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 11 converge on pivot from oversight to fabrication; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural verb of making or assigning with partner-ascription arguments
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, appointing, or deeming; locally narrowed to assigning partners to God
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلُوا۟}} ({{tr:jaʿalū}}) names a completed collective act of making or assigning, with the plural subject left implicit but recoverable from the polemical group. Its partner-ascription argument frame exposes the claim as an imposed relation rather than recognition of an existing reality.

topics.headline: fabricated partner-ascription
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the partners are produced by ascription, not discovered as real counterparts.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 12 converge on fabricated partner-ascription; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: dative preposition marking the target of the imposed relation
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) places God at the front of the false assignment. The preposition makes the offense relational: partners are being assigned to Him.

topics.headline: false assignment aimed at God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the partner claim imposes a relation upon God before the partners are even named.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 13 converge on false assignment aimed at God; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name governed by the dative in the partner-ascription
words.root_gloss_range: worship and deity language; locally the proper divine name resisting class-member treatment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is governed by the preceding dative preposition as the target of partner-ascription. The proper divine name, carrying worship/deity pressure, resists being treated as one member among comparable beings, and its recurrence later as nominative agent reverses the human attempt to assign relation.

topics.headline: divine name as polemical pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proper divine name stands between universal oversight and the fabricated partner claim.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 14 converge on divine name as polemical pivot; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative plural object of partner-ascription
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, partnership, and divided participation; locally the alleged partners assigned to God
words.prose: {{ar:شُرَكَآءَ}} ({{tr:shurakāʾa}}) is an indefinite plural object, so the alleged partners are many but unspecified. The {{ar:ش ر ك}} ({{tr:sh-r-k}}) idea of shared participation is narrowed here to a claim the next imperative immediately forces into a naming test.

topics.headline: unnamed plural partners fail the naming test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the partners multiply as an indefinite claim while remaining unnamed and evidentially weak.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 15 converge on unnamed plural partners fail the naming test; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: bare imperative to say, shifting narration into direct address
words.root_gloss_range: saying and speech; locally the command that introduces the challenge
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) compresses the speech verb into a direct command. It turns the narrative into address and makes the challenge itself an ordered act of saying.

topics.headline: commanded speech launches the challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reply is not reported passively; speech itself becomes a commanded challenge.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 16 converge on commanded speech launches the challenge; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperative with object pronoun demanding the alleged partners be named
words.root_gloss_range: naming, marking, poison, and narrow-point imagery; locally narrowed to formal designation
words.prose: {{ar:سَمُّوهُمْ}} ({{tr:sammūhum}}) addresses the claimants and carries the alleged partners in its object suffix. The command makes naming an evidentiary test of concreteness, while the {{ar:س م م}} ({{tr:s-m-m}}) field is narrowed from name, poison, and needle-eye pressure into piercing formal specification.

topics.headline: naming demand tests concreteness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim is forced to become concrete: name them, or expose their emptiness.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 17 converge on naming demand tests concreteness; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: disconnected disjunctive particle opening the first horn of the challenge
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) opens the first disconnected alternative. It does not merely offer a balanced option; it escalates the challenge into an impossible claim about informing God.

topics.headline: first disconnected alternative escalates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question moves from naming failure into a sharper alternative.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 18 converge on first disconnected alternative escalates; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperfect addressing the claimants with God as object pronoun
words.root_gloss_range: weighty news and report; locally narrowed to the absurd claim of informing God
words.prose: {{ar:تُنَبِّئُونَهُ}} ({{tr:tunabbiʾūnahu}}) sustains direct address and makes God the object of their alleged informing. The {{ar:ن ب أ}} ({{tr:n-b-ʾ}}) field of weighty news makes the question more pointed: are they reporting to Him what He supposedly does not know? Variant-form evidence affects intensity or causation, but the local rebuke remains an informing claim turned absurd.

topics.headline: presumptuous informing of God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reversal: the claimants are made to sound as though they are delivering news to God.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 19 converge on presumptuous informing of God; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: preposition introducing the content about which they claim to inform
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) after the informing verb marks the alleged content. It keeps the question topical: what exactly are they claiming to tell God?

topics.headline: content of the alleged report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the problem is the content of the report, not a causal reason for it.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 20 converge on content of the alleged report; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun opening the clause of what God supposedly does not know
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the content clause after the content preposition. Its open relative force lets the absurdity expand: whatever they allege would fall under what God supposedly does not know.

topics.headline: relative object under negated knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object remains open-ended, making the claim of unknown partners unlimited and therefore impossible.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 21 converge on relative object under negated knowledge; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: negation particle denying the following indicative knowing verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the indicative knowing verb, not a prohibition. The rhetoric forces the partner claim into a reductio: it would require saying that God does not know of them.

topics.headline: negation creates the reductio
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the partner claim is made to imply something impossible: divine non-knowledge.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 22 converge on negation creates the reductio; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect knowing negated inside the rhetorical challenge
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, marking, and sign/landmark associations; locally certain divine knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) is the knowing verb negated for the sake of the challenge. The {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) field includes mark and landmark pressure, but it is narrowed here to certain knowledge, contrasting their verbal claim with what would have to be known in the earth.

topics.headline: divine knowledge versus mere claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the debate is shifted from assertion to knowledge: if the partners were real, they would be within God’s knowing.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 23 converge on divine knowledge versus mere claim; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition giving the non-knowledge claim its domain
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) gives the question a domain. It turns the earth into the locative field where the alleged partners would have to be known.

topics.headline: earth as locative scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alleged unknowns are tested within the observable earthly domain.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 24 converge on earth as locative scope; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive earth under the locative preposition
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, and grounded domain; locally the searchable field of the challenge
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is definite and governed by the locative preposition. The {{ar:أ ر ض}} ({{tr:ʾ-r-ḍ}}) range is narrowed to the earthly domain of evidence, where their claim still cannot produce a known referent.

topics.headline: known earth as evidence domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenge is grounded in the known earth, not left in vague metaphysical space.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 25 converge on known earth as evidence domain; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: second disconnected disjunctive particle closing the rhetorical fork
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) completes the paired rhetorical alternatives. After the impossible claim of informing God, the second horn demotes the partner claim to outward speech.

topics.headline: second alternative completes the dilemma
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim is trapped between impossible knowledge and mere verbal surface.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 26 converge on second alternative completes the dilemma; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking outward speech as the medium or substitute evidence
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marks the medium of the second alternative. It makes surface speech function as their substitute for proof.

topics.headline: speech-surface as instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their claim survives only as a manner of saying, not as evidence.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 27 converge on speech-surface as instrument; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active participle/adjective specified by speech
words.root_gloss_range: appearing, backing, supporting, and being outward; locally outward surface contrasted with substance
words.prose: {{ar:ظَٰهِرٍ}} ({{tr:ẓāhirin}}) names an outward layer and is specified by the following speech phrase. The {{ar:ظ ه ر}} ({{tr:ẓ-h-r}}) range includes support and appearance, but the local phrase narrows it to verbal surface standing in place of substance.

topics.headline: outward appearance without hidden substance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim has only an outward verbal face, not a grounded reality beneath it.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 28 converge on outward appearance without hidden substance; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: explanatory preposition specifying the outward layer as speech
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) specifies what the outward layer belongs to. It binds the outward participle to speech before the corrective diagnosis arrives.

topics.headline: surface belongs to speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the outwardness is not general appearance but specifically a surface of speech.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 29 converge on surface belongs to speech; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun naming speech as a category
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speech, and attribution; locally speech that may lack truth-value substance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْلِ}} ({{tr:al-qawli}}) abstracts the speech category, including utterance that can be assigned or attributed without truth-value substance. In contrast with the commanded speech earlier, the word makes human claim-speech visible as something that can be only outward and unsupported.

topics.headline: speech category without truth guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between commanded speech and hollow speech in the same ayah.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 30 converge on speech category without truth guarantee; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: corrective particle rejecting the prior alternatives and introducing the real diagnosis
words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) performs the corrective turn after the two alternatives. It rejects both the impossible knowledge claim and the surface-speech cover, then divides the challenge from diagnosis as the ayah turns into verdict.

topics.headline: corrective pivot into diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that neither rhetorical horn is accepted; the ayah turns to the real cause.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 31 converge on corrective pivot into diagnosis; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: Form II passive perfect whose singular subject is the following scheming
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, adornment, and attractive display; locally deception made attractive
words.prose: {{ar:زُيِّنَ}} ({{tr:zuyyina}}) is a Form II passive that anticipates the following plotting noun as its singular subject. The {{ar:ز ي ن}} ({{tr:z-y-n}}) field makes the diagnosis visual and evaluative: deception appears beautified, while the passive leaves the beautifying agent unstated and the active-voice reading only sharpens the agency contrast.

topics.headline: beautified deception with hidden agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their plot is not merely chosen; it has been made attractive to them.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 32 converge on beautified deception with hidden agent; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: dative preposition marking those for whom the scheme is beautified
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) marks the recipients of the beautification. The dative frame makes the adorned scheme their experienced reality.

topics.headline: recipients of beautification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the beautification is experienced by the rejecters as something for them.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 33 converge on recipients of beautification; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: plural relative pronoun introducing the clause that identifies the group
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) delays the named scheme until the group is defined. The relative clause ties identity to the following act of rejection.

topics.headline: group defined by rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is identified by its act before its scheme is named.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 34 converge on group defined by rejection; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural verb defining the group by rejection
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, ingratitude, and unbelief; locally rejection as covered response
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) defines the group with a completed plural act. The {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) image of covering survives as the moral posture that makes beautified self-deception coherent.

topics.headline: completed covering as group posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that beautified plotting is attached to a completed posture of covering over truth.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 35 converge on completed covering as group posture; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: verbal noun with possessive suffix functioning as passive subject
words.root_gloss_range: strategy, plotting, and turning a course; locally their possessed scheme
words.prose: {{ar:مَكْرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:makruhum}}) names their plotting as a possessed process and, in the main reading, the subject of the preceding passive beautification verb. The {{ar:م ك ر}} ({{tr:m-k-r}}) field of strategy is narrowed by the passive diagnosis: their own scheme is made attractive and later stands under God’s total counter-disposal at 13:42.

topics.headline: possessed plotting made attractive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the very scheme they own becomes the thing beautified to them.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 36 converge on possessed plotting made attractive; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: connector joining beautified plotting to path obstruction
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the diagnosis moving from adorned plotting into path obstruction. The connector makes the second clause part of the same chain rather than a separate aside.

topics.headline: adornment linked to obstruction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that beautified plotting and obstruction belong to one diagnostic chain.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 37 converge on adornment linked to obstruction; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural with passive-active reading dispute in the obstruction formula
words.root_gloss_range: turning away, blocking, and repelling; locally obstruction from the path
words.prose: {{ar:صُدُّوا۟}} ({{tr:ṣuddū}}) sits at a passive-active voice fork, but both possibilities stay inside the {{ar:ص د د}} ({{tr:ṣ-d-d}}) obstruction field. With the following path phrase, the verb turns the beautified plot into route-blockage, a formulaic pattern also visible in 47:1 and 47:32.

topics.headline: blocked or blocking from the path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a voice fork: they are either barred from the path or active in barring others, and both readings intensify the obstruction scene.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 38 converge on blocked or blocking from the path; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: separative preposition binding obstruction to the path image
words.prose: {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) supplies the separative force after the obstruction verb. It makes misguidance feel like being turned away from a route, not merely holding a wrong opinion.

topics.headline: separation from the route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the loss is spatialized as movement away from the path.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 39 converge on separation from the route; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: definite singular path noun governed by the separative preposition
words.root_gloss_range: road, way, means, course, and cause; locally the recognized way of guidance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّبِيلِ}} ({{tr:al-sabīli}}) is singular and definite, so the route is treated as recognized. The {{ar:س ب ل}} ({{tr:s-b-l}}) range includes way and means, narrowed here to the known path of guidance; its loss prepares the closing denial of any guide.

topics.headline: one recognized path and means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the obstruction is from the known path and means of guidance, not one route among many.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 40 converge on one recognized path and means; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as narrowed.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector launching the final conditional while preserving sequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes into the final conditional. It preserves sequence after the obstruction clause while giving the closing rule its own syntactic start.

topics.headline: fresh conditional verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing verdict is a fresh sentence, not merely an appendage to the passive clause.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 41 converge on fresh conditional verdict; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle governing misguidance and its result
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) returns with a changed function: not the opening relative pronoun, but a conditional whoever. The repeated form links the opening comparison to the closing verdict while universalizing the result.

topics.headline: conditional whoever universalizes the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the close expands from the diagnosed group to a general rule about anyone God misguides.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 42 converge on conditional whoever universalizes the verdict; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: Form IV jussive verb governed by the conditional particle
words.root_gloss_range: straying, being lost, vanishing, perishing, and forgetting; locally causative misguidance by God
words.prose: {{ar:يُضْلِلِ}} ({{tr:yuḍlili}}) is jussive under the conditional and Form IV in force. The {{ar:ض ل ل}} ({{tr:ḍ-l-l}}) range of straying, becoming lost, and vanishing from the recoverable path is narrowed to causative misguidance by God, locked against the closing guide term in the formula found in 7:186, 39:36, and 40:33.

topics.headline: causative misguidance under condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misguidance is grammatically causative and placed under God’s agency before the no-guide result.

words.gloss_range: postverbal nominative divine name as subject of the causative verb

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) appears as the explicit nominative subject of the causative misguidance verb. The divine name has moved from the genitive target in the shirk claim to the active agent of judgment, overturning the attempted assignment of partners.

topics.headline: explicit divine agency restored
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God moves from target of false assignment to named agent of the final verdict.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 44 converge on explicit divine agency restored; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: answer particle introducing the apodosis of the conditional
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) introduces the answer to the condition. Because the result begins with negation, the particle moves from divine misguidance to absence of guide in one grammatical step, making the no-guide clause an inevitable consequence rather than a loose comment.

topics.headline: result particle makes the closure consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the absence of a guide is the formal consequence of divine misguidance.

words.gloss_range: negation particle beginning the final denial of guide availability
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) begins the final negation. In the closing no-guide stack, it opens a categorical denial of remedial guidance after divine misguidance.

topics.headline: categorical no-guide negation

topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 46 converge on categorical no-guide negation; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: fronted dative/possessive phrase locating absence for the misguided person
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) places the person affected by the result at the front of the negated clause. The dative frame makes guidance unavailable for him, not merely absent in abstraction.

topics.headline: loss assigned to the person

topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 47 converge on loss assigned to the person; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: preposition under negation intensifying denial over the whole guide class
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) works under negation as the absolutizing element. The final stack moves from negation to personal loss to universal denial: no guide of any kind remains available.

topics.headline: min universalizes the absence

topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for word 48 converge on min universalizes the absence; QAC alignment and local constraint evidence support retaining the topic as used.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active participle under emphatic negation naming the denied guide-role

The {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) range is narrowed to an external guide who could lead out; the yā-retention variant changes the final sound-shape without changing the no-guide meaning, and the absence closes against the causative misguidance verb while forming a participle arc with the opening standing participle.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening standing-over construction, total quantifier, self, earning, and knowledge.
baseline_models.mechanism: A continuous custodian encompasses each whole self and the accrual attached to it; exhaustive knowledge makes the proposed co-agents rhetorically impossible.

activation_trace.role: Care, preservation, and governance make the standing relation continuous custodial oversight.
Enclosure and completion extend that oversight without remainder.
The self as a thing in its full identity makes the object an entire person, not an isolated act.
Acquisition supplies the accrual that adheres to each self.
Knowledge as disclosure grounds oversight in fully uncovered evidence.

changed_reading.before: A generic assertion that God observes everyone's deeds.
changed_reading.after: An active custodial-accounting relation holds every whole self and its accrual within exhaustive governance, excluding any genuine co-agent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of making partners, naming them, reporting what is unknown, and offering outward speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: A status is assigned, then a name and visible mark are attached, and finally speech tries to pass that assignment off as a discovered referent. The divine knowledge challenge exposes fabrication rather than discovery.

activation_trace.role: Making something occupy a status supplies the initial manufacture of partnerhood.
Shared participation supplies the relation being asserted rather than independently demonstrated.
A name as designation supplies the verbal label expected to identify a referent.
A visible identifying mark turns naming into an attempted public certification.
Attributing what did not exist supplies the mechanism by which speech invents rather than reports.
Outward exposure makes the assertion perceptible while leaving its depth unproved.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely asks for the idols' names.
changed_reading.after: It stages an audit of reference: naming and marking try to manufacture a partner that exhaustive knowledge finds nowhere.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Beautification, turning away, the path, misdirection, and the absence of a guide form a causal sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Attraction makes a constructed course persuasive; aversion and active diversion then interrupt a traversable way, producing loss of direction that no secondary guide can repair.

activation_trace.role: Displayed attractiveness supplies the lure that makes the obstructive course seem desirable.
Aversion and active diversion provide the transition from attraction to blocked movement.
An extended traversable road gives the mechanism a concrete route and destination.
Departure from direction supplies the resulting state once the route is obstructed.
Gentle direction to a road supplies the missing restorative function at the close.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief and misguidance are static labels.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts a process: attraction recruits movement, diversion breaks the route, and the resulting disorientation becomes resistant to outside correction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of beautification, covering, the unusual dye branch under scheming, and outward speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: The asserted partners become a cosmetic layer: beautification applies a persuasive finish, covering hides what the finish lacks, and the scheme behaves like coloration laid over a merely outward claim.

activation_trace.role: Active enhancement supplies the attractive finish applied to the claim.
Covering supplies the concealment beneath that attractive finish.
The dye image gives the scheme an exploratory material role as coloration rather than an independent substance.
The outer side opposed to an interior localizes the cosmetic claim at the surface.

changed_reading.before: Their scheme is only a hidden plan.
changed_reading.after: Their scheme can also be carried as a beautified coating whose visible success depends on covering the absence beneath it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context separates visible structure from unseen support while coupling creation to active management. That distinction turns outward speech into a load-bearing test: does the named partner have any operative reality beneath its visible label?

activation_trace.role: Outward visibility supplies the surface whose supporting depth is being tested.
An identifying mark supplies the public label that may or may not rest on reality.
A supporting prop supplies the absent load-bearing element behind what is seen.
Managing by regard for outcomes supplies the operative depth that a mere label lacks.

structural_cues: 13:2 contrasts visual access with an unshown support structure and then moves to active management.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unseen support and management; I infer that a name likewise needs an operative support, while the live alternative is a simpler contrast between divine knowledge and ordinary rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: Outward speech is simply superficial wording.
changed_reading.after: Outward speech is an unsupported structure: visible and nameable, but lacking the hidden causal support that would make its referent real.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's unexpected irrigation branch for the focus scheme meets neighboring plots, cultivation, and one water supply. The scheme can therefore be carried as conduct that is fed and grown until it yields an attractive but obstructive crop.

activation_trace.role: Watering land and growth gives the scheme an exploratory cultivation mechanism.
Displayed attractiveness supplies the appealing yield of that cultivation.
Growing a crop supplies the process by which a disposition becomes established produce.
Giving drink supplies the recurrent input that sustains the cultivated scheme.
Delivering water by pouring supplies the shared material channel feeding divergent outcomes.

structural_cues: 13:4 places neighboring plots and divergent yields under one water source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, common irrigation, and unequal yield; I map that process onto the focus inventory's watering branch, while ordinary strategic scheming remains the live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The obstructive scheme appears fully formed as a private plan.
changed_reading.after: It may also be a cultivated yield, repeatedly nourished within shared conditions until its attractiveness helps block the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: A guide and warning can be socially present while effective direction remains contingent on return. The focus denial therefore concerns the failure of guidance to take hold, not necessarily the physical absence of a guiding speaker.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a road supplies the function declared unavailable at the focus close.
Departure from direction supplies the state in which guidance fails to operate.
A guide for a social group establishes that guiding presence can still exist in the wider scene.
Warning that awakens caution distinguishes notice from successful orientation.
Direction toward the destination supplies the positive counterpart to focus misdirection.
Habitual return supplies the receptive movement linked to effective guidance.

structural_cues: 13:7 gives every people a guide; 13:27 links actual guidance to turning back.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both a standing guide and guidance associated with return; I infer a distinction between availability and uptake, while the alternative is that the statements address unrelated levels of guidance.

changed_reading.before: No guide is present for the misled person.
changed_reading.after: A guide may be present and warning may sound, yet no guiding function can restore a route that the self does not turn back toward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured knowledge, surrounding attendants, preservation, and assigned accounting turn the opening standing relation into layered administration: observation, protection, self-change, and reckoning occupy distinct but coordinated levels.

activation_trace.role: Care and governance supply the coordinating custodial relation.
Total enclosure extends the administration across every case.
The whole self supplies the unit being preserved, changed, and assessed.
Acquisition supplies the accountable accrual produced by that unit.
A bounded measure supplies exact scope rather than vague omniscience.
Guarding and preserving supply an attendant layer beneath total governance.
Counting and account supply the terminal assessment assigned to the governing side.

structural_cues: 13:8-11 moves from exact measure to attendants before and behind, then to change within selves.
13:40 separates human conveyance from divine accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, guarding, self-change, and account; I infer coordinated administrative layers under the focus custodian, while a live alternative treats these as separate assurances of power.

changed_reading.before: The opening describes a solitary watcher.
changed_reading.after: It describes a layered custodial system that measures, guards, permits self-change, records accrual, and finally accounts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named partners function like false addresses. Calls can be emitted toward them, but no answer or completed reach returns; later worship, calling, and return align around one effective endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Designation supplies the endpoint label to which discourse is routed.
Calling by speech supplies the outbound attempt to contact the named endpoint.
A returned answer supplies the reciprocal function that the false endpoint lacks.
Arrival at a goal supplies the delivery condition that repeatedly fails.
The open mouth supplies the concrete destination that the extended hands cannot reach.
Submissive worship supplies the allegiance properly routed to the effective endpoint.
Return to a homeward destination supplies the completed inbound path absent from false address.

structural_cues: 13:14 moves from address to nonresponse to failed arrival.
13:36 aligns worship, calling, and return toward one endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, answer, reach, worship, and return; I model them as a routing circuit, while the alternative is a narrower analogy limited to ineffective petition.

changed_reading.before: The invented names merely lack external referents.
changed_reading.after: They are false relational addresses: speech can be sent toward them, but no answer, delivery, allegiance, or return circuit can close.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context asks whether the partners produced comparable creation and whether resemblance caused confusion. Partner-making thus becomes a classification error driven by surface similarity rather than evidence of rival causation.

activation_trace.role: Assigning a status supplies the act of placing candidates into the partner category.
Shared participation supplies the category whose evidence is being tested.
Surface visibility supplies the level at which resemblance can misclassify.
Origination supplies the causal output a genuine co-agent would have to demonstrate.
Confusion caused by similarity supplies the epistemic error behind false sharing.
Blindness of discernment supplies the inability to distinguish similar surfaces from causal identity.

structural_cues: 13:16 places powerlessness, blindness, darkness, alleged co-creation, and confusing resemblance in one interrogation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the creation test and resemblance question; I infer a category-error mechanism, while the alternative is that resemblance is only a reductio with no account of how association arose.

changed_reading.before: Partners are asserted through arbitrary naming alone.
changed_reading.after: Arbitrary naming is aided by surface resemblance: similar-looking effects are misread as evidence of shared creative agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water flow and metallurgical heat both produce elevated foam around useful processes. This activates outward speech, beautification, covering, and dye as a buoyant decorative residue: generated by real energies, visually dominant, but unable to remain.

activation_trace.role: Outward exposure localizes the claim at the visible layer.
Applied attractiveness supplies the residue's persuasive appearance.
Coloring with dye supplies a material overlay for the decorated scheme.
Floating froth supplies a conspicuous upper layer with little stable substance.
Adornment supplies the attractive metallurgical aim around which residue forms.
A claim with no reality supplies the semantic status of the decorated residue.
Stable waiting supplies the durability test that useful substance passes and foam fails.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats foam in hydraulic and metallurgical processes, then contrasts cast-off residue with lasting benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, heat, adornment, foam, falsehood, and remaining benefit; I map that material sequence onto the focus surface claim, while the alternative is that the analogy concerns truth generally rather than the focus naming episode.

changed_reading.before: The decorated scheme is a static facade.
changed_reading.after: It is process residue: a bright upper layer thrown up by social energies, mistaken for substance until durability separates it from what benefits and remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covenant sequence distinguishes bonds that must be kept and joined from bonds that are broken and severed. Partner-making becomes an unauthorized attachment added while required connections are cut, and path obstruction becomes the topology produced by those wrong links.

activation_trace.role: Shared attachment supplies the illicit connection added to the relation.
Diversion supplies the movement failure caused by the wrong connection pattern.
A traversable road supplies the network whose continuity is disrupted.
Undoing a firmly built bond supplies structural failure rather than mere disagreement.
A confirmed covenant supplies the legitimate bond that should remain intact.
Joining one thing until it adheres to another supplies correct relational continuity.
Severing connection supplies the complementary removal of required ties.
Departure from sound order supplies the system-level result of illicit joining and required severing.

structural_cues: 13:20-25 alternates covenant, joining, breaking, cutting, and corruption before returning to consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legitimate and illegitimate connection operations; I infer a relational topology for partner-making and path blockage, while the live alternative keeps covenant-breaking and association as separate offenses.

changed_reading.before: Association is an isolated false belief.
changed_reading.after: Association is wrong connectivity: an invented attachment is added while commanded bonds are cut, deforming the route people then fail to traverse.

context_deltas.mechanism: A clear articulated judgment can stand with knowledge, whereas following inclination after knowledge destroys protection. The defect in outward speech is therefore not clarity or external expression itself, but expression detached from knowledge and steered by desire.

activation_trace.role: Outward manifestation supplies the ambiguous surface whose value the context qualifies.
Audible utterance supplies expression that can be either grounded or empty.
Disclosed knowledge supplies the criterion that distinguishes valid expression from facade.
Accurate wisdom and knowledge supply the grounding of the articulated judgment.
Explicit articulation supplies a positive case of outward clarity.
Following in another's track supplies the behavioral transfer from knowledge to misdirection.
The self's inclination supplies the force that can steer clear words away from known truth.

structural_cues: 13:37 places clear judgment before a warning against following inclinations after knowledge has arrived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear articulation, sound judgment, knowledge, and desire-led following; I infer that visibility is neutral and grounding is decisive, while the alternative keeps the focus phrase as a fixed idiom for empty assertion.

changed_reading.before: Anything outward or plainly verbal is inherently suspect.
changed_reading.after: Clear outward speech can be sound; the condemned surface is speech without epistemic support, especially when desire redirects what knowledge already disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A term has an authoritative record, and erasure or confirmation belongs to the holder of the source record. Arbitrary naming now resembles an attempted registry entry made without the power to establish, preserve, or prove it.

activation_trace.role: Designation supplies the proposed entry name.
Attribution of what was not supplies the unauthorized registration attempt.
An inscription that establishes judgment or decree supplies authoritative registration for each term.
Removal of an effect supplies authority to delete what lacks continued standing.
Proof and establishment supply authority to confirm what genuinely stands.
Entering a name in a register supplies the formal counterpart to the focus naming challenge.

structural_cues: 13:38 attaches a record to each term; 13:39 centralizes erasure, confirmation, and the source record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies term-bound record, erasure, confirmation, and a source register; I infer a registry audit of names, while the live alternative reads the record only as decree rather than referential authorization.

changed_reading.before: Naming fails because the proposed beings are unknown.
changed_reading.after: Naming also fails institutionally: speakers cannot enter a partner into the authoritative register or give the label proof and persistence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence assigns accounting and irreversible judgment to God, places the whole field of scheming within divine possession, repeats knowledge of every self's earning, and ends with sufficient witness. The focus custodian therefore contains and adjudicates schemes rather than merely watching them.

activation_trace.role: Governance and care supply the standing field that contains subordinate action.
Counting and account assign final reckoning to the governing field.
Binding judgment supplies adjudication that no counter-move can reverse.
Completeness without remainder supplies total containment of the scheming field.
Disclosure to the knower repeats the focus evidence relation at the close.
Acquisition repeats the exact accountable accrual attached to each self.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies public evidentiary closure.
Carrying an affair through to sufficiency supplies the adequacy of that witness without a co-agent.

structural_cues: 13:42 assigns the entire field of scheming to God and then restates knowledge, earning, totality, and the self.
13:43 closes the dispute with sufficient witness and knowledge of the record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies totality, exact restatement, judgment, account, and witness; I infer active containment and counter-strategy, while the alternative leaves the focus standing relation as observation alone.

changed_reading.before: God watches opponents execute an external rival scheme.
changed_reading.after: Their scheme never stands outside the governing field: it is contained, exposed through each accrual, judged, and answered by sufficient witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a hunter's-snare branch to a split-root entanglement branch; it remains anchored in the focus partners, diversion, and road, but downstream prose should mark it as a material path analogy rather than a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Partners, active diversion, and the road permit a capture mechanism within the focus sequence.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's snare supplies the invented partner as a device that catches movement.
A blocking mountain supplies a barrier built into the route.
The extended road supplies the place in which the snare and barrier operate.
Entanglement in a trap or tether activates capture as the downstream cost of the blocked route.

changed_reading.before: People are abstractly deceived away from the path.
changed_reading.after: The invented partners may be pictured as snares set into the route, converting attraction into capture and hardship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This economic reading is cross-domain and branch-led; it remains anchored in standing, earning, partnership, account, and reduction, but should be rendered as an audit analogy rather than as the verse's direct financial sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Standing over earnings beside an asserted partnership supports an appraisal frame.

activation_trace.role: Valuation and appraisal turn the standing figure into an exploratory assessor.
Acquired gain supplies the account being assessed.
Shared ownership supplies the false equity claim made against the account.
Counting and account make the appraisal inspectable rather than rhetorical.
A requested price reduction activates shrinking valuation at the edges of the claimed share.

changed_reading.after: They can be carried as unauthorized equity claims that a total assessor marks down against the actual earnings of each self.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `ك س ب/B001` is self-acquisition of gain. Standing over every self is paired with what it earns, and 13:42 repeats universal knowledge of acquisition. I infer continuous accountability over consequences selves bring into their own records.
2. `س م و/B005` is a name as raised designation. `سَمُّوهُمْ` demands stable reference, while absent knowledge and outward speech expose empty claims. I infer naming as an audit of referential and causal substance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:42 confirmed that plotting first becomes the plotter's own acquisition, completing the accountability mechanism introduced here.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Naming tests whether a raised designation has any referent behind its surface.** `س م و / B005` is a name as raised designation, `ن ب ء / B002` is news brought and reported, and `ظ ه ر / B003` is the upper or outer surface. The command “name them” is followed by two tests: report unknown earthly information, or admit an outward layer of speech. Nearby 13:31 has refused to relocate divine command into a recited instrument, and 13:36 will contrast reception of the book with denial of part of it. I assign naming the role of making a claim conspicuous, report the role of supplying its referent, and outward speech the role of an unsupported surface. The packet supplies labels without corresponding known entities; I infer designation without reportable causal content -> verbal construction. The challenge is thus evidential, not a request for additional titles.

2. **Acquisition leaves a trace even when decoration reverses its perceived value.** `ك س ب / B001` is seeking and obtaining benefit, `ز ي ن / B002` is making beauty show, `ص د د / B001` is turning aside, and `س ب ل / B001` is an extended traversed way. The ayah begins with every self under what it acquired, then describes a scheme made attractive and a resulting diversion from the way. I assign decoration the role of changing perceived value without changing the acquired act's accountability. The packet supplies acquisition, beautification, and diversion; I infer altered appearance -> path error, while the underlying gain remains legible. The verse reads the scheme as a valuation failure that becomes spatial misdirection.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:38's authorization-bound sign made the naming challenge sharper: a genuine agent is not produced by a label but located within an actual chain of permission and effect. 13:36-37's joined book and clear judgment likewise contrasted articulated content with `ظاهر من القول`.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Each self acts under standing oversight, accumulates consequences, and enters a reckoning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guardianship and economic acquisition converge in an administered ledger.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Standing Custodian Over the Self
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A responsible custodian stands over each living self, maintaining and governing its charge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: standing care and governance (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); living self or life-principle (`quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`); inward faculty of reason and awareness (`quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`); taking charge of another's affair (`quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`); sufficiency through carrying out an affair (`quranic:root_001310:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Standing, governing, sufficiency, and the living inward self form a custodial scene. Oversight is continuous care over an accountable subject.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Each self acts under standing oversight, accumulates consequences, and enters a reckoning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guardianship and economic acquisition converge in an administered ledger.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Acquisition Entered Into Reckoning
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Each self acquires an outcome, which is known, counted, and returned as consequence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: seeking and acquiring benefit (`quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`); causing another to acquire (`quranic:root_001296:B002/m01`); numerical reckoning (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); practical accounting of conduct (`quranic:root_000318:B006/m01`); resulting end of an action (`quranic:root_001033:B006/m01`); knowledge that discloses the act (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `كَسَبَت` (ك س ب) and `يَعْلَم` (ع ل م); 13:40-41 `الحِسَاب` (ح س ب); 13:42 `تَكْسِب` (ك س ب), `يَعْلَم` (ع ل م), and `عُقْبَى` (ع ق ب).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Acquisition, disclosure, accounting, count, and consequence create a ledger process. What the self "earns" is both an acquired holding and an entry that matures into an outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A claim seeks standing through names and surface speech, but testimony requires disclosed knowledge and a written referent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Naming and testimony are separated as different evidentiary operations.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Unsupported Naming and Report
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker assigns names, attributes a claim, and offers only outward wording for an absent referent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: naming as designation (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); report conveying information (`quranic:root_001464:B002/m01`); attribution of words that were not said (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); assigning a divine partner (`quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`); outward appearance as opposed to interior (`quranic:root_000970:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `سَمُّوهُم` (س م و), `تُنَبِّئُونَه` (ن ب ء), `شُرَكَاء` (ش ر ك), `ظَاهِر` (ظ ه ر), and `القَوْل` (ق و ل).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Naming, reporting, attribution, and outward wording form a claim-making scene without evidentiary depth. A label cannot supply the missing referent it purports to identify.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Orientation depends on a traversable route whose guide and markers can be opposed by barriers and diversion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance becomes road engineering: route, leading figure, beacon, barrier, and deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Route, Leader, and Beacon
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A clear road is marked and entered behind a guide or leading point.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: extended traversable road (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`); gentle guidance toward road and truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); leader or foremost part that guides (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); clear road across easy ground (`quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`); beacon or waymark (`quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `السَّبِيل` (س ب ل), `هَاد` (ه د ي), and `تُنَبِّئُونَه` (ن ب ء); 13:35 `النَّار` (ن و ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Road, leading figure, easy ground, and beacon make guidance a concrete route scene. The path is legible because its direction is embodied in marks and a forerunner.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Orientation depends on a traversable route whose guide and markers can be opposed by barriers and diversion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance becomes road engineering: route, leading figure, beacon, barrier, and deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Barrier, Diversion, and Turning Away
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A barrier blocks the route, diverts travelers from its line, and turns them away from their destination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: obstructing and turning away (`quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`); mountain barrier (`quranic:root_000848:B005/m01`); wandering from the intended route (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); deviation from straightness and resistance to truth (`quranic:root_001052:B001/m01`); turning one's back in withdrawal (`quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Obstruction is more than refusal: a barrier interrupts the road, produces deviation, and ends in withdrawal. The absent guide leaves no leader to restore direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 - Decorated Plot and Concealed Spoilage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An attractive exterior can be applied as a coating while corruption persists beneath it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmetic pigment, covering, and spoiled fruit provide a material anatomy for self-deception.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Applied Surface Beauty
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A surface is beautified and coated so that its outward appearance commands attention.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: actively displaying a thing as beautiful (`quranic:root_000660:B002/m01`); ochre pigment used as coating or dye (`quranic:root_001438:B004/m01`); outward appearance and exposure (`quranic:root_000970:B001/m01`); covering a thing from view (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `زُيِّن` (ز ي ن), `مَكْرُهُم` (م ك ر), `ظَاهِر` (ظ ه ر), and `كَفَرُوا` (ك ف ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Beautifying, pigmenting, displaying, and covering make one cosmetic operation: the visible surface is improved precisely by controlling what remains unseen.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 - Decorated Plot and Concealed Spoilage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An attractive exterior can be applied as a coating while corruption persists beneath it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmetic pigment, covering, and spoiled fruit provide a material anatomy for self-deception.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Spoiled Interior and Denial
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Beneath the improved surface, food or material decays while the subject refuses recognition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: spoiled date or moist fruit (`quranic:root_001438:B006/m01`); consumption turning to bodily or material corruption (`quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`); denial contrary to recognition (`quranic:root_001550:B001/m01`); inward inclination and desire (`quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Spoilage, corrosive consumption, denial, and desire supply the hidden state beneath the decorated plot. The channel pressures attractive scheming by exposing it as cosmetic treatment over decay.
